live.name: NICKEL HYATT
live.headline: NICKEL HYATT: a threat actor known by many names
live.in_short: NICKEL HYATT is the Secureworks name for an actor also tracked as APT45 and Andariel. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: NICKEL HYATT is the name Secureworks uses for this threat actor.
It is also tracked under other names, including APT45, Andariel, Dark Seoul, Jumpy Pisces, Onyx Sleet, RIFLE Campaign, Silent Chollima, Stonefly and UN614.
The catalogue lists these tools for the actor: ActiveX 0-day, DTrack, HazyLoad, HotCriossant, Rifle, UnitBot and Valefor.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.headline: NICKEL HYATT: a North Korea-nexus actor also tracked as Andariel and APT45
next.in_short: NICKEL HYATT goes by many names, including Andariel, APT45 and Silent Chollima. CrowdStrike assesses it is likely tied to a North Korean intelligence bureau and says it has been active since at least 2007.

sentences.t: NICKEL HYATT is also tracked as APT45, Andariel, Dark Seoul, Jumpy Pisces, Onyx Sleet, RIFLE Campaign, Silent Chollima, Stonefly and UN614.
CrowdStrike calls the actor SILENT CHOLLIMA and describes it as a North Korea-nexus adversary that has been active since at least 2007.
CrowdStrike assesses the group is likely affiliated with Lab 110, within Bureau 3 of North Korea's General Reconnaissance Information Bureau. CrowdStrike states this as likely, not confirmed.
CrowdStrike lists other community names for the actor, including Lazarus Group, PLUTONIUM, New Romanic Cyber Army, WASSONITE and UNC614.
CrowdStrike gives the actor's objectives as financial gain, intellectual property theft, intelligence gathering and destruction. It lists the motivations as state-sponsored and criminal.
The catalogue lists these tools for the actor: DTrack, HazyLoad, HotCriossant, Rifle, UnitBot, Valefor and an ActiveX zero-day.
A public code repository describes a server emulator for SHATTEREDGLASS ransomware, which it attributes to Andariel. The page offers no analysis, so this is a weak source.
